purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0100 in the gauge arena: a color-symmetric permutation rule can only relabel slots (2 of 9! pair permutations, 1 for a color-anticolor pair, 6 for three slots), the color-symmetric pair unitaries are a circle whose only classical points are identity and swap, every other point entangles, and a tone that is also the clock keeps only 3 of the 9 color generators.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
